how: Each answer below was read off the live CDC PneumoRecs VaxAdvisor (https://www2a.cdc.gov/vaccines/m/pneumo/) by clicking through its questions in a browser on 2026-10-25 and copying the recommendation it printed. The tool's own page metadata reads cdc:last_updated content="December 15, 2024".

answers: Has the patient ever received PCV13, PCV15, or PCV20? -> No
captures.printed: Give 4 doses of PCV1: Three doses, preferably 8 weeks apart (minimum 4 week intervals), then last dose between the ages of 12 through 15 months (given at least 8 weeks after third dose). Schedule is then complete.
